levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
أبو حيان التيمي يحيى بن سعيد

notes: Two branches joined by «ح» meet at «عن أبي زرعة، عن أبي هريرة»: that tail is written once after the last «ح» and belongs to both branches (rule 3).
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss and is left out.
The Companion (أبو هريرة) is the last link; the Prophet's words to Bilal are the saying.
